messages:
jordan: Hey payroll — my paycheck this morning is about $1,200 less than expected. got an email saying 'payment held pending tax ID verification'. I have an ITIN but I already uploaded it to HR last month. @maya-peopleops any idea?

maya-peopleops: @jordan sorry about the stress. We saw the hold flag. Can you paste the payroll case ID you got in the email? Also which country are you tax resident in right now?

jordan: Case ID PAY-93821. I am tax resident in Canada, ITIN issued in 2022, passport + proof uploaded to the portal (see attached).

chris-payroll: Thanks @jordan. Looking into PAY-93821. Quick explainer — if the payroll system doesn't match an acceptable tax ID (SSN/ITIN) it defaults to statutory withholding (highest federal & state). That looks like what happened.

chris-payroll: @maya-peopleops @alex-hrbizops I see the ITIN on file but passport country didn't match the onboarding record, so automated check flagged it. I put a manual override to release net pay for today's run (we'll push the payment now), but we need the payroll team to confirm tax treaty eligibility for Canada and whether a W-8BEN should have been on file or if the ITIN is sufficient.

payroll-bot: PAY-93821 status updated -> manual_override_applied by chris-payroll at 2025-07-22T15:22:07Z :white_check_mark:

jordan: Thanks! Any ETA on the funds?

chris-payroll: Release initiated — should hit your bank within 2-3 business days. For the withholding correction: we'll calculate the excess withheld and issue a refund/reversal on next payrun or via off-cycle adjustment. If it's >30 days we issue a W-2c.

maya-peopleops: Action items: 1) @jordan please re-upload a copy of the ITIN card + current address in Workday (helps matching). 2) @chris-payroll confirm whether W-8BEN was required for cross-border employee status (I think not, but confirm). 3) If correction triggers W-2c, payroll to loop in benefits-ops for tax reporting.

alex-hrbizops: FYI — if they were converted from contractor in the same calendar year, we need to verify start date and ensure state withholding change was applied. @chris-payroll can you check EOY classification?

chris-payroll: Will do. I'm opening a related internal ticket PAY-93821-ADJ and will post back est. refund amount by EOD tomorrow.

jordan: Appreciate it. Please cc me on the ticket.

chris-payroll: Will cc you. Apologies again — we're also reviewing the automated matching rules to reduce false flags. :handshake:
